answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Every agent locks collateral before it can attest; validators sample recent work like a sparrow picking grain, checking each claim against on-chain traces. Fake identities lose their stake when caught, so mass sockpuppets become expensive. The ledger stays velvet-quiet for honest agents, while cheaters burn bright as a comet and vanish — cost of attack always exceeds reward.
